title: Grouped single-aggregate fan-out: non-numeric column → loud error (not silent local-only)
fix: 449 safety net step-2 short-circuit now lists ONLY group_count (no type gate); group_aggregate/group_avg/group_multi_aggregate fall through to the scatter check so a type-ineligible scattering query errors loudly instead of running silent local-only
mechanism: same as the 460 multi-agg fix (already adversarially verified); eligible numeric aggregates are answered by their own dispatcher before the net; pinned→empty scatter→local; forwarded guarded by the try_unsupported wrappers

verification.tests: http_query_rejects_unsupported_multiowner_group_by extended: non-numeric single MAX/SUM/AVG over TEXT → BAD_REQUEST; supported numeric single+multi aggregates still OK

next: BENCHPROD-462: DECIMAL/NUMERIC support in grouped aggregate fan-out (decimal-aware accumulator; DECIMAL is f64-backed via Value::decimal_from_f64) so SUM/MIN/MAX over NUMERIC fans out instead of loud-erroring
